title: Seattle Coffee Walking Tour Specialty Cafes and Local Stories
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join a local guide for a walking tour of Seattle’s popular Capitol Hill neighborhood - sample three unique coffee drinks, from three of Seattle's favorite independent Cafes. Meet your guide at the historic Oddfellows Building then set out to explore the cafes and stories that have helped define this vibrant neighborhood. Capitol Hill has long been the home of the city's counterculture, night life and it is the heart of Seattle's Specialty Coffee Culture - making it the perfect place to dive in to the drink that has helped shape the city and the modern world. Tasty drinks, great company and superb local stories.
